title: Pullman's garden colonnade stands in its pictures' proportions
items: The domed colonnade at the east end of Pullman's glasshouse range across 18th Street now rises from a taller stone podium to a deep entablature, with shorter columns between them, as the 1894 Inland Architect plate and Lowe's c. 1897 photograph both show it.
The podium's top and the entablature's underside now carry on the range's own string courses, at about 1.6 m and 4.65 m.
